articles.summary: InvenTrust Properties Corp. (“InvenTrust” or the “Company”) (NYSE: IVT) today reported financial and operating results for the period ended September 30, 2021 and provided guidance for 2021. For the three months ended September 30, 2021, the Company reported Net Income of $4.0 million, or $0.06 per basic share, compared to $1.7 million, or $0.02 per basic share, for the three months ended September 30, 2020.
